security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Start, stop and pair the Crosstalk hub from the menu bar
bundle.longDescription: Crosstalk Hub shows whether the Crosstalk hub on this computer is running, and starts, stops, restarts and pairs it without a terminal. The hub itself keeps running when the app quits.
